name: Read info
summary: Reads the .info attribute of each condition in an MNE evoked file and writes it to a text file for viewing.
description: Small utility for inspecting MEG/EEG metadata (channels, sampling rate, filters, projectors) of evoked data. Writes info.txt and shows the same text in the brainlife product view. It reads no configuration parameters.

inputs.description: MNE evoked data (one or more conditions).

outputs.description: Text dump of each evoked condition's .info (info.txt).

citations.text: Hayashi S, et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nat Methods 21:809-813 (2024).
